<!-- pr-reviewer: ff457b1661f6a0a1c363b416ef048af6799a62ff -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Two test-only edits, one added field each (`basis_version: 1`); no assertion changed, no product code touched.
- `1` is the right value: `Tilt` docs say 0 preserves the pre-#2133 frame and 1 ignores trigonometric dust, and every tilt a new op gets already uses 1 (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/fields.rs:224`, `crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs:296`, migration `project/json.rs:40`).
- No other old-shape `Tilt` literal remains: every `Tilt {` literal in the workspace carries `basis_version` (the multi-line ones in `frame.rs` and `tests/tilt.rs` were already updated by #2157; clippy `--all-targets` compiles them all).

**Results (merged with upstream/main 768834bc7, which the head already contains; run on host dude, locally)**
- clippy `-D warnings`, geometry/cl/tools/post/sim/motion/app/ui, `--all-targets`: green
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test section_mode`: 2 passed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib section_mode`: 1 passed
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 147 + 3 + 3 passed

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes:** the long line at `posting_section_mode.rs:133` may want rustfmt; not blocking. Author is the coordinator session, so this is the independent review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
